info.title: VMEG Open API
info.description: Integrate VMEG into your product: translate and dub video or audio, synthesize speech, clone voices, translate plain text, and manage API-side files. All responses use `{ code, message, data }`; `code === 200` means success.

tags.name: Media translation
tags.description: Localize uploaded video or audio end-to-end: transcribe speech, translate the script, generate AI dubbing (cloned or preset voices), and return new dubbed media. Optional subtitles and lip sync. **Async only** — dubbed files arrive via [Webhook](/guides/webhooks). This is not plain text translation; see [Media translation](/guides/products/media-translation).

tags.name: TTS
tags.description: Turn text into natural speech with preset or cloned voices. **Sync** returns audio URLs in the HTTP response; **async** delivers results via [Webhook](/guides/webhooks). See [Text to speech](/guides/products/text-to-speech).

tags.name: Voice clone
tags.description: Create a reusable voice from a short reference recording. Returns a `voiceId` you can pass to TTS or translate-and-dub jobs. See [Voice clone](/guides/products/voice-clone).

tags.name: Text translation
tags.description: Translate plain text segments — no audio or video processing. For spoken content in media files, use **Video & audio translate and dub** instead. See [Text translation](/guides/products/text-translation).

tags.name: Task management
tags.description: List, inspect, or delete jobs created through any product API. Poll `GET .../tasks/detail` when you cannot rely on webhooks. Scoped to your **API Key**. See [Products overview](/guides/products/overview).

tags.name: Assets - Materials
tags.description: Upload and manage video/audio files used as input for translate-and-dub jobs. Flow: finish the full upload (presigned or multipart → register) → pass the registered `materialId` to create-async. See [Material upload](/guides/assets/material-upload).

tags.name: Assets - Voices
tags.description: List preset voices for TTS, or manage voices you cloned. Cloned voices are created via **Voice cloning**. See [Voices](/guides/assets/voices).

post.description: Convert text to speech in one request. Audio URLs are returned immediately in the HTTP `data` payload — no webhook required.
Submit a long or batch TTS job. The HTTP response only confirms acceptance (`taskId`). Finished audio arrives in your [Webhook](/guides/webhooks) callback (`event`: `openapi-tts`).

200.description: Acceptance only (`taskId`, `createdAt`). Final results are in the [Webhook](/guides/webhooks) callback request body.

post.description: HTTP **request body** VMEG POSTs to your [Webhook](/guides/webhooks) URL when a Text to speech async task finishes. The JSON field `event` is `openapi-tts` (see [Webhook request body](/guides/webhook-request)). Not part of the create-async **Response** above. Full schema: [Create TTS (async)](/api-reference/tts/create-tts-async) → **Callbacks**.

Translate plain text segments in one request. Translated strings are returned immediately in the HTTP `data` payload. Does **not** process video or audio — use **Create translate and dub job** for media.
Submit a batch text translation job. The HTTP response only confirms acceptance (`taskId`). Translated segments arrive in your [Webhook](/guides/webhooks) callback (`event`: `openapi-translate`).

200.description: Acceptance only (`taskId`, `createdAt`). Final results are in the [Webhook](/guides/webhooks) callback request body.

post.description: HTTP **request body** VMEG POSTs to your [Webhook](/guides/webhooks) URL when a Text translation async task finishes. The JSON field `event` is `openapi-translate` (see [Webhook request body](/guides/webhook-request)). Not part of the create-async **Response** above. Full schema: [Create text translation (async)](/api-reference/text-translation/create-text-translation-async) → **Callbacks**.
Clone a speaker from a short reference recording in one request. On success, returns `voiceId` — reuse it in TTS or translate-and-dub jobs.
Submit a voice cloning job. The HTTP response only confirms acceptance (`taskId`). The new `voiceId` arrives in your [Webhook](/guides/webhooks) callback (`event`: `openapi-clone-voice`).

200.description: Acceptance only (`taskId`). Final results are in the [Webhook](/guides/webhooks) callback request body.

post.description: HTTP **request body** VMEG POSTs to your [Webhook](/guides/webhooks) URL when a Voice clone async task finishes. The JSON field `event` is `openapi-clone-voice` (see [Webhook request body](/guides/webhook-request)). Not part of the create-async **Response** above. Full schema: [Create voice clone (async)](/api-reference/clone-voice/create-voice-clone-async) → **Callbacks**.

Start an async **translate and dub** pipeline for uploaded video or audio: transcribe speech → translate script → generate AI dubbing (voice clone or presets) → render dubbed output. Optional subtitles and lip sync via `options`. The HTTP response only confirms acceptance (`taskId`). Dubbed video/audio URLs arrive in your [Webhook](/guides/webhooks) callback (`event`: `openapi-media-translation`).

If you request audio translation (`taskType`: `at`) but the material is video, the server may run video translation (`vt`) instead — check `taskType` in the acceptance response.

200.description: Acceptance only (`taskId`, `taskType`, `status`, `createdAt`). Final results are in the [Webhook](/guides/webhooks) callback request body.

post.description: HTTP **request body** VMEG POSTs to your [Webhook](/guides/webhooks) URL when a Media translation async task finishes. The JSON field `event` is `openapi-media-translation` (see [Webhook request body](/guides/webhook-request)). Not part of the create-async **Response** above. Full schema: [Create media translation (async)](/api-reference/media-translation/create-media-translation-async) → **Callbacks**.

get.description: Paginated list of jobs you submitted (translate-and-dub, TTS, text translation, voice clone). Filter by `taskType` and `status`. Scoped to your **API Key**. Async deliverables still arrive via [Webhooks](/guides/webhooks) — use this endpoint to browse history or reconcile missed callbacks.

Poll status and `result` for one `taskId` — use after any `create-async`, or when webhooks are unavailable. For translate-and-dub jobs, `result` includes dubbed media CDN URLs when `status` is complete. Scoped to your **API Key**.

post.description: Delete a task record. Requires [`X-Idempotency-Key`](/guides/idempotency). See [Products overview](/guides/products/overview).

Single-file upload **step 1**: get a presigned PUT URL and `materialId`. Upload the file to the URL, then call **Complete single-file upload**. Required before **Create translate and dub job**. See [Material upload](/guides/assets/material-upload).
Single-file upload **step 3**: register the file after CDN PUT. Requires [`X-Idempotency-Key`](/guides/idempotency). Flow: [Material upload](/guides/assets/material-upload).
Multipart upload **step 1**: start upload and get `materialId` / `uploadId`. Requires [`X-Idempotency-Key`](/guides/idempotency). Flow: [Material upload](/guides/assets/material-upload).
Multipart upload **step 2**: presigned URL per part. Requires [`X-Idempotency-Key`](/guides/idempotency). Flow: [Material upload](/guides/assets/material-upload).
Multipart upload **final step**: commit parts and register the material. Requires [`X-Idempotency-Key`](/guides/idempotency). Flow: [Material upload](/guides/assets/material-upload).
Cancel an in-progress multipart upload. Requires [`X-Idempotency-Key`](/guides/idempotency). See [Material upload](/guides/assets/material-upload).

get.description: Paginated library of video/audio files you uploaded for translate-and-dub jobs. Pass `materialId` to **Create translate and dub job**. See [Materials](/guides/assets/materials).

post.description: Logical delete of a material. Requires [`X-Idempotency-Key`](/guides/idempotency). See [Materials](/guides/assets/materials).
List read-only preset voices for **Synthesize speech** requests. Pick a `voiceId` from the response. See [Voices](/guides/assets/voices).
List cloned voices created by [Voice clone](/guides/products/voice-clone). See [Voices](/guides/assets/voices).
Rename a cloned voice display name. Requires [`X-Idempotency-Key`](/guides/idempotency). See [Voices](/guides/assets/voices).
Logical delete of a cloned voice. Requires [`X-Idempotency-Key`](/guides/idempotency). See [Voices](/guides/assets/voices).

apiKeyAuth.description: Send your API Key in the **`Authorization`** header (`Bearer <api_key>`). See [Authentication](/guides/authentication).

IdempotencyKey.name: X-Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on mutating `POST` requests that create tasks or change persisted data (max 64 characters). See [Idempotency](/guides/idempotency).

IdempotencyKeyRequired.name: X-Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyRequired.description: Required on mutating `POST` requests that create tasks or change persisted data (max 64 characters). See [Idempotency](/guides/idempotency).

message.description: Human-readable detail when `code` is not success

OpenApiTaskType.description: Open API task type code. For media translation create request, use `taskType` codes `vt` (video translation) or `at` (audio translation).

provider.description: Deprecated — do not send. Pass `voiceId` on each line instead. See [Text to speech](/guides/products/text-to-speech) and [Supported clone methods](/guides/supported-clone-methods#text-to-speech-voiceid-and-batch-rules).

trim.description: When `true`, trim leading and trailing silence from output audio

data.description: Lines to synthesize (max 50). Each item needs `text` and a [Voices](/guides/assets/voices) `voiceId` or `timbreRefAudio`

voiceId.description: System or cloned voice ID for this line. See [Voices](/guides/assets/voices); or use `timbreRefAudio` instead

timbreRefAudio.description: HTTPS reference audio when not using a [Voices](/guides/assets/voices) `voiceId`

emoRefAudio.description: HTTPS URL of reference audio for emotion or delivery style

emoPrompt.description: Text hint for desired emotion or speaking style

errorMessage.description: Failure reason when synthesis failed for this item

OpenApiTaskAcceptedData.description: Immediate response for async task submission (no task results)

taskId.description: Open API task ID; use for polling or correlation

createdAt.description: Returned by TTS and text translation async create

data.description: Synthesis results returned in the synchronous HTTP response.

language.description: Source and target locales for translation

options.description: Optional translation settings (context, scene, glossary, prompt)

OpenApiTranslateSpeakerGender.description: Speaker gender for a translation segment

gender.description: Speaker gender for this segment. Enum: `male` or `female`.

speaker.description: Speaker label for multi-speaker content; helps keep pronouns and voice consistent across segments

locale.description: Per-segment locale when it differs from `language.source`

context.description: Per-segment neighbor lines. Takes priority over `options.sourceContext`; useful with `provided_only` when segments are not time-contiguous

start.description: Start time in seconds on the source timeline. Pair with `end` to mark this segment's time span for neighbor context

end.description: End time in seconds on the source timeline. Must be provided with `start` and be greater than or equal to `start`

sourceContext.description: How to use surrounding source text. Defaults to `independent` when omitted

glossary.description: Term glossary map (source term → preferred translation)

prompt.description: Custom prompt appended to the translation instruction

skipMissingTranslationCheck.description: When `true`, skip validation that every segment received a translation

OpenApiTranslateSourceContext.description: Global strategy for using neighbor context. Lower priority than per-segment `context`

mode.description: `independent` — translate each segment alone. `provided_only` — use neighbor text supplied in segment `context`. `neighbor` — auto-pick neighbors from ordered segments using `contextWindow`

contextWindow.description: Only when `mode` is `neighbor`: number of segments before and after the current one to include (1–20)

scene.description: Content type hint for the translation model

allowStutter.description: Whether disfluencies (stutters) in the source may be preserved in the translation

errorMessage.description: Failure reason when translation failed for this segment

items.description: Translated segments, aligned with request segments by index

data.description: Translated segments returned in the synchronous HTTP response.

voiceName.description: Display name for the cloned voice in your asset library

sampleText.description: Optional transcript of `refAudio` to improve clone quality

voiceId.description: New cloned voice ID for TTS. See [Voices](/guides/assets/voices)

data.description: Clone result returned in the synchronous HTTP response.

materialId.description: Registered material ID from a **fully completed** [Material upload](/guides/assets/material-upload) (or from [List materials](/guides/assets/materials)). Do not use a mid-upload ID from gen-upload-url / multipart initiate.

OpenApiMediaTranslationSource.description: Input material for this translation job

source.description: Source locale (BCP-47) or `auto` for detection. See [Supported languages](/guides/supported-languages).

OpenApiMediaTranslationLanguage.description: Source and target locales for localization

mode.description: How voices are assigned across speakers

OpenApiMediaTranslationTranslate.description: Text translation step inside the media pipeline

prompt.description: Custom prompt for the translation step

enable.description: Enable dynamic length matching between source and dubbed video

OpenApiMediaTranslationLipsync.description: Lip sync (video translation only; may add credits). See [Pricing](/guides/pricing)

enable.description: Enable lip sync on the output video

OpenApiMediaTranslationSelectedVoice.description: A preset or cloned voice selected for dubbing

provider.description: Optional preset tier (`S1`, `S2`, …) when you pick a system voice. Clone voices use `V1`–`V5`. See [Voices](/guides/assets/voices).

voiceId.description: Voice ID from [List system voices](/api-reference/assets/voices/list-system-voices) or your cloned voices

OpenApiMediaTranslationVoiceSpeakers.description: Speaker and timbre configuration for dubbing

selectedVoicesList.description: Explicit voice picks per speaker slot

speakerNum.description: Number of speakers to detect (`auto` or a numeric string)

timbreMethod.description: `clone` — clone from source audio. `smart` — smart voice matching

OpenApiMediaTranslationOptions.description: Pipeline options: dubbing, ASR, translation, separation, lip sync, and captions

text.description: Title and subtitle styling / burn-in configuration (product-specific object)

taskType.description: vt = video translation, at = audio translation. If `at` is used with a video material, the job may run as video translation

source.description: Input material for this translation job

language.description: Source and target locales for localization

extraData.description: Optional client metadata; echoed in the completion webhook

OpenApiExtraData.description: Optional client metadata on async submit; echoed in the completion webhook (`extraData` in callback body). Not used on sync create endpoints.

OpenApiMediaTranslationAcceptedData.description: Immediate response for media translation async create (no deliverables)

taskType.description: Effective task type (may differ from request when audio material is processed as video translation)

OpenApiMediaTranslationCallbackData.description: Task payload inside webhook `data` when `event` is `openapi-media-translation`. `data.result` with CDN deliverables.

result.description: Fixed, sanitized customer result (CDN URLs + trimmed fields).

OpenApiMediaTranslationCustomerResult.description: Media translation customer result (fixed shape). CDN URLs are HTTPS.

provider.description: Voice tier on this line — preset `S1`, `S2`, … or clone `V1`–`V5`. Keep with `voiceId` when you edit or resubmit lines. See [Voices](/guides/assets/voices).
Voice tier on this line — preset `S1`, `S2`, … or clone `V1`–`V5`. Keep with `voiceId` when you edit or resubmit lines. See [Voices](/guides/assets/voices).

result.description: Task-specific result; structure varies by taskType

s3Uri.description: Upload target S3 URI from gen-upload-url or multipart initiate

materialId.description: Material ID from presigned upload. See [Materials](/guides/assets/materials)

materialId.description: Material ID from multipart initiate. See [Materials](/guides/assets/materials)

eTag.description: ETag from the S3 part PUT response

materialId.description: Material ID from multipart initiate. See [Materials](/guides/assets/materials)

fileHash.description: MD5 hash of the full file

parts.description: Uploaded parts with `partNumber` and `eTag` from each PUT

materialId.description: Material ID from multipart initiate. See [Materials](/guides/assets/materials)

uploadId.description: Multipart upload session ID to abort

fileHash.description: MD5 hash of the file (must match initiate)

mimeType.description: MIME type of the main file

fileHash.description: MD5 hash of the main file

uploadUrl.description: Presigned PUT URL; empty when instant upload (dedup) applies

material.description: Present when the file already exists (instant upload)

s3Uri.description: Upload target S3 URI; pass to complete

materialId.description: Material ID for this upload. See [Materials](/guides/assets/materials)
Material ID for this multipart upload. See [Materials](/guides/assets/materials)

s3Uri.description: Upload target URI; pass to complete-upload

topIds.description: Pin these preset `voiceId` values to the top. See [Voices](/guides/assets/voices)

OpenApiCallbackEnvelope.description: Shared top-level fields of the webhook POST body when an async task finishes. See [Webhook request body](/guides/webhook-request) for the `event` field and per-product values.

version.description: API version of the task (e.g. `v1`, `v2`). Matches the version in the request path (`/openapi/v1/...`).

event.description: Which product completed. Route your handler by this value: `openapi-tts` (TTS), `openapi-translate` (text translation), `openapi-clone-voice` (voice clone), `openapi-media-translation` (media translation). Listed in [Webhook request body](/guides/webhook-request).

pipelineKey.description: Stable ID for this async completion. Deduplicate webhook handling by this value — see [Webhook request body](/guides/webhook-request#deduplicate-by-pipelinekey).

extraData.description: Echo of `extraData` from your async submit request

OpenApiTtsTaskCompletedCallback.description: Webhook callback **request body** for Text to speech when `event` is `openapi-tts`. `data` includes synthesis `results` and `taskId`. See [Webhook request body](/guides/webhook-request) and [Create TTS (async)](/api-reference/tts/create-tts-async) → **Callbacks**.

data.description: Product-specific results when `event` is `openapi-tts`. `data` includes synthesis `results` and `taskId`.

OpenApiTranslateTaskCompletedCallback.description: Webhook callback **request body** for Text translation when `event` is `openapi-translate`. `data.items` holds translated segments aligned with your request. See [Webhook request body](/guides/webhook-request) and [Create text translation (async)](/api-reference/text-translation/create-text-translation-async) → **Callbacks**.

data.description: Product-specific results when `event` is `openapi-translate`. `data.items` holds translated segments aligned with your request.

OpenApiCloneVoiceTaskCompletedCallback.description: Webhook callback **request body** for Voice clone when `event` is `openapi-clone-voice`. `data.voiceId` (and related fields when successful). See [Webhook request body](/guides/webhook-request) and [Create voice clone (async)](/api-reference/clone-voice/create-voice-clone-async) → **Callbacks**.

data.description: Product-specific results when `event` is `openapi-clone-voice`. `data.voiceId` (and related fields when successful).

OpenApiMediaTranslationTaskCompletedCall.description: Webhook callback **request body** for Media translation when `event` is `openapi-media-translation`. `data.result` with CDN deliverables. See [Webhook request body](/guides/webhook-request) and [Create media translation (async)](/api-reference/media-translation/create-media-translation-async) → **Callbacks**.
